L'Esperienza

A little piece of Italia

Four reasons guests come back to Casa Italia Cucina — and bring everyone they know.

Cucina Italiana

Hand-rolled pasta, wood-fired pizza, and signature seafood dishes — built around the recipes of Southern Italy.

Cocktail Bar

Spritz, negronis, and seasonal citrus cocktails poured beneath a wall of glowing oranges and lemons.

Photo-Worthy Spaces

The lemon wall, the Amalfi street signs, the marble fountain — every corner is built for a memory worth sharing.

Waterfront Views

Right on Bayside Marina. Watch the cruise ships glide past while you twirl your forkful of cacio e pepe.

Galleria

An Italian postcard

From the lemon wall to the lobster pasta — a peek inside Bayside's most photographed Italian restaurant.
